summary: Reaching a space's custom games tapped the game menu entry it had just seen; on a live-browser stack the space's screen can move on by itself before the tap lands (the host's chosen game arrives, the menu settles), and the tap then waited 5 s for an entry that was gone ('node game-menu-hearts tap: Timed out', 'element is gone'). A tap whose target has gone now looks again at what the space shows.
